name: Apna Time Bhi Aayega
description: Apna Time Bhi Aayega is a Hindi family-drama series. It depicts the dreams and struggles of Ramadheer, a servant in a royal family of Jaipur, and his beloved daughter, Rani. While Ramadheer doesn’t wish for Rani to become a servant, circumstances force Rani to take that path. Will Rani fulfil her dreams, or will she remain a servant like her father?

videos.title: Rani Arrives in Jaipur to meet her Father
videos.overview: Residing in Ballia, Rani has a piece of good news she wants to share with her father Ramadheer. She arrives in Jaipur with her little brother Pinku to meet him. Further, she comes across a doctor.
